review.scope: Maintainer review of the exact public npm archive: identity, version, SHA512, SHA1, byte length, public entry points, browser UI and dependency declarations, with byte equality against the locally accepted release archive. Final source commit passed make check, make build and forty-package packed installation on macOS ARM64 and Linux ARM64 Ubuntu Docker with real Linux sandbox checks. Six native targets passed strict architecture, digest and assembly checks; cross-compilation does not establish runtime acceptance on every target. Linux x64 native Debian source gate acceptance is a historical user handoff at 59cd8eb0ff4a3d4bdf92689c78417a229f2c2c81 under the previous package scope; its remote logs were unavailable for this local review. No final Linux x64 execution is claimed. Supported catalog targets are macOS ARM64 and Linux x64 by the maintainer's accepted release scope. Source is private; commit binding is maintainer supplied. GitHub Actions evidence and npm provenance are absent. Windows runtime acceptance, other architectures, exhaustive dependency security audits and paid provider calls are outside this review.
